terbaru.judul: mjorbit: A Simulation Framework for Space Robotics
terbaru.pelajaran: Next, we present mjorbit, a general, flexible, and performant framework built on the MuJoCo engine widely used in robotics, to which we add key spacecraft dynamics, actuators, and sensors.

terbaru.judul: Online Change-point Detection for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose \emph{Patterns of Past Rewards} (PPR), a lightweight algorithm-agnostic detector that smooths agents' return streams, highlights recent changes, and applies a statistical drift detector to flag significant shifts.

terbaru.judul: Reinforcement Learning for Sequential Solar PV Policy Design under Uncertainty: An Agent-Based Approach
terbaru.pelajaran: This study formulates PV policy design as a sequential decision problem and integrates reinforcement learning (RL) with a stochastic agent-based model (ABM) that simulates yearly solar PV adoption under uncertainty.

terbaru.judul: LookThere! Sparse Vision by Reinforced Selection
terbaru.pelajaran: We show that LookThere only selects the task-specific input, excelling at sparse recognition in high-resolution settings (traffic signs, billiards), and maintaining accuracy with as little as 0.2% of the input.

terbaru.judul: When Models Edit Too Much: On the Fidelity of Minimal Code Edits
terbaru.pelajaran: We study over-editing, the tendency of a model to rewrite code beyond what is required to fix a bug.

terbaru.judul: A Semantic-Aware Multiple Access Scheme Leveraging Spatial Redundancy for Uplink-Dominant Network Services
terbaru.pelajaran: To address this, we introduce a novel multiple access scheme designed for uplink-dominant network services.

terbaru.judul: Integrating Fairness and Explainability in a Multiple Instance Reinforcement Learning System
terbaru.pelajaran: This study investigates a multi-objective framework that combines reinforcement learning-based multiple instance learning (RL-MIL), adversarial debiasing, and preference-conditioned hypernetworks for student-at-risk prediction.

terbaru.judul: CaRL-EM: Cost-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Entity Matching with LLMs
terbaru.pelajaran: Entity matching (EM) requires fine-grained contextual understanding and domain knowledge.

terbaru.judul: Reinforcement Learning and Rule-Based Peer-to-Peer Pricing in Residential PV-BES Communities
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper compares rule-based and learning-based pricing mechanisms for peer-to-peer (P2P) electricity trading in residential photovoltaic communities.
